artifact_scope: Authored finite abstractions, not extracted production models. No repository source tests run.
proof_ceiling: Exhaustive only for each listed finite transition system; no unbounded liveness, production reachability, cross-host, IO, independent-review or release certification.

defective.name: bootstrap circular prerequisites
defective.assumptions: Four state variables; safe intact root storage and quorum already available; three required hosts. The bad model requires traffic-ready to recover metadata. The repair changes only that dependency.

repaired_abstraction.name: bootstrap circular prerequisites
repaired_abstraction.assumptions: Four state variables; safe intact root storage and quorum already available; three required hosts. The bad model requires traffic-ready to recover metadata. The repair changes only that dependency.

defective.name: effect-boundary physical fencing
defective.assumptions: Two generations, one delayed effect, one replacement. Repair serializes exact-generation validation with the sink effect; a separate pre-check would not satisfy this model. Positive coverage requires an actual effect on generation 1, not merely a safe refusal.

shortest_counterexample.event: late STOP resolves logical name to current generation

repaired_abstraction.name: effect-boundary physical fencing
repaired_abstraction.assumptions: Two generations, one delayed effect, one replacement. Repair serializes exact-generation validation with the sink effect; a separate pre-check would not satisfy this model. Positive coverage requires an actual effect on generation 1, not merely a safe refusal.

defective.name: shared overflow budget
defective.assumptions: Two distinct operations, one spare slot, no release/restart. Repaired reservation is atomic, stored by the existing budget owner, and uniquely keyed by operation.

repaired_abstraction.name: shared overflow budget
repaired_abstraction.assumptions: Two distinct operations, one spare slot, no release/restart. Repaired reservation is atomic, stored by the existing budget owner, and uniquely keyed by operation.

defective.name: read/register lost-wake interval
defective.assumptions: One readiness transition, reliable callbacks to registered listeners, one dirty bit. Crash or dropped notifications require an additional fair rescan; this model does not certify those.

shortest_counterexample.event: authoritative prerequisite becomes ready; notify current subscribers

repaired_abstraction.name: read/register lost-wake interval
repaired_abstraction.assumptions: One readiness transition, reliable callbacks to registered listeners, one dirty bit. Crash or dropped notifications require an additional fair rescan; this model does not certify those.

defective.name: historical decision vs current permission
defective.assumptions: One immutable transaction identity/manifest, two coordinator epochs, one known durable COMMIT. The repair preserves the commit fact, not the old coordinator's permission to initiate new effects.

shortest_counterexample.event: commit decision becomes durable under coordinator epoch 1
coordinator replacement advances scheduling epoch to 2
replacement rejects known commit because its issuing epoch is old

repaired_abstraction.name: historical decision vs current permission
repaired_abstraction.assumptions: One immutable transaction identity/manifest, two coordinator epochs, one known durable COMMIT. The repair preserves the commit fact, not the old coordinator's permission to initiate new effects.

defective.name: replay evidence through topology handoff
defective.assumptions: One request, one split/migration, one lost reply. Initial apply/result storage is atomic. Repair retains replay evidence with data before ownership publication; GC is a separate obligation.

shortest_counterexample.event: parent atomically commits write and result receipt; reply lost
publish child with rows but without replay receipt
retry identical logical request at new owner

repaired_abstraction.name: replay evidence through topology handoff
repaired_abstraction.assumptions: One request, one split/migration, one lost reply. Initial apply/result storage is atomic. Repair retains replay evidence with data before ownership publication; GC is a separate obligation.

defective.name: incomparable CDC positions
defective.assumptions: Two independent ordered streams with one valid unseen event each, positions A:100 and B:1. No global total-order owner exists. Stream incarnation/lineage changes are not modeled.

repaired_abstraction.name: incomparable CDC positions
repaired_abstraction.assumptions: Two independent ordered streams with one valid unseen event each, positions A:100 and B:1. No global total-order owner exists. Stream incarnation/lineage changes are not modeled.

defective.name: bounded replay metadata
defective.assumptions: One request, one retention expiry, one delayed retry. Demonstrates that receipt GC must be coupled to identity retirement or an equivalent authoritative retention protocol; cannot promise unlimited replay with finite evidence.

shortest_counterexample.event: apply write and retain replay result; reply lost
collect result after local timeout; leave identity usable
retry missing record as new work
